title: Appearance
subtitle: Choose the theme, brand accent, interface density and motion. Changes are saved on this device immediately.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Light or dark. Saved to your account and carried across your devices.
theme.darkHint: Easier on the eyes at night

accent.title: Brand colour
accent.description: Changes the colour of every interactive element, immediately.

density.title: Interface density
density.description: Tune the spacing and row size to suit your screen.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: The speed and range of transitions between screens.

contrast.title: High contrast
contrast.description: Strengthens borders and text to meet accessibility requirements.
contrast.label: Enable high contrast
contrast.hint: Suits bright rooms or reduced vision.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: How the core components look with the current settings.

motionSystemOverride: Your system asks for reduced motion, so “Reduced” is applied automatically. The control above resumes working as soon as you change the system preference.
